narration.full_text: Now, let's quickly review some key concepts from our lesson on trigonometry. This section is designed to help you solidify your understanding of trigonometric ratios. We'll go through flashcards to reinforce what you've learned. Pay close attention to the relationships between the sides and angles of a right-angled triangle. This will be a great way to test your memory and ensure you're ready to apply these concepts.
